name: TABULA RASA
source:
Midnight is a transformation mage who lives deep in the woods. Folks seek out their skills to free themselves from dysphoria, while the mage dreams of freedom in a different way. On one relaxed afternoon, a client appears with an unusual request..

[From [url=https://cadnomori.itch.io/tabularasa]itch.io[/url]]
